NRL Stars Express Concerns Over Rule Changes, Official Responds

National Rugby League (NRL) players have voiced concerns that rule changes, specifically 'set restarts', could significantly influence the outcome of finals matches. However, NRL chairman Peter V'landys has dismissed these fears, stating the players are 'not telling the truth'. The specific nature of the rule changes and the exact reasons for player apprehension were not detailed in the coverage.
